    Privacy & available editions

    This edition includes single-list CSV, HTML and PDF output. It has no payment lock, expiry, account or telemetry. The 25 MB/20,000 record parser and 100 PDF page bounds protect browser memory; they are not payment thresholds.

    A separately distributed batch edition can produce different price tiers and specific product overrides. It is not included in this free plugin. Sales are not open during this validation stage.
